decisions.reason: As a low-cost add-on to the core web-mapping platform, it remains worth keeping open despite weak visibility because its complementary value can still be realized through existing clients and projects.
As the firm's flagship GIS platform and a central vehicle for its strategic direction, it is very unlikely to be withdrawn and would normally continue to anchor related offerings.

After several years the market potential of this standalone mobile field-capture product should be clearer, and if it still lacks strong visible traction its higher upkeep is better reallocated to the core platform and new development.
